definition: Labels describe the current report in the fictional text, not verified real-world data loss. Null means ambiguous and is excluded only from that quality metric.

labels.rationale: Explicit current loss of previously saved contacts; recovery is unresolved.
Saved notes count as saved data even though the parent records remain.
Current missing saved groups and memberships; multiple users observe it.
Even one unresolved missing saved record qualifies.
Missing saved fields are data loss reports; corroboration is in the text.
Unresolved technical loss takes routing precedence over the billing issue.
Saved attachments are in scope; an unresolved subset still qualifies.
Current missing saved metadata with no reported recovery.
Pricing inquiry without disruption or missing data.
Billing-only problem; no application disruption is described.
A specific task is blocked; the message explicitly denies missing data.
Single-user access task blocked without a data-loss report.
Minor cosmetic defect with no blocked task.
Widespread core-service outage is severity 2 without implying missing saved data.
Feature request; neither a technical incident nor billing.
Partnership inquiry with explicit callback request and no disruption.
Negation and visible full list outweigh empty search results; search is blocked.
Pure hypothetical/general guidance request; no current incident.
Resolved technical incident; historical appearance of loss is not current loss.
Unsaved draft is excluded; no task remains blocked.
A proposed benign explanation was ruled out; loss is currently unresolved.
Historical loss belongs to another product; current issue is billing-only.

The message does not report that previously saved data is missing; it describes an empty workspace with unknown history. The question explicitly excludes inferring loss from that alone. The blocked task and technical routing are clear.

One teammate explicitly reports currently missing saved records. The simultaneous denial does not resolve or explain that report: report detection is positive and possible-loss severity is 2, without asserting actual data loss.

review_record.statement: User confirmed reviewing all 24 tickets and agreeing with the proposed labels.
